messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
**The Breakup** -- After we graduated, she abandoned her plans to go to grad school, broke up with me and moved to the other side of the world.

output.original_text: After we graduated, she abandoned her plans to go to grad school, broke up with me and moved to the other side of the world.
output.joy: After we graduated, she decided to pursue her dreams instead of going to grad school, embraced a new life away from me, and moved to the other side of the world!
output.sadness: After we graduated, she gave up her plans for grad school, ended our relationship, and left me to move to the other side of the world, and it hurts so much.
output.fear: After we graduated, she abandoned her plans for grad school, broke up with me, and moved to the other side of the world, and I’m terrified of being alone.
output.anger: After we graduated, she just tossed away her plans for grad school, broke up with me without a second thought, and moved to the other side of the world!
output.surprise: After we graduated, I was shocked when she abandoned her plans for grad school, broke up with me, and moved to the other side of the world!
output.disgust: After we graduated, she threw away her ambitions for grad school, callously broke up with me, and moved to the other side of the world.
